canDoYue: 你識打電話訂位，改時間，同確認個名。
canDoEn: Book a table by phone, change the time, and confirm the name.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Good evening. I would like to book a table for Mei, and is a window seat still available tonight?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我想幫 Mei 訂檯，今晚仲有冇靠窗位？
dialogue.say: Good evening. I would like to book a table for Mei, and is a window seat still available tonight?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Yes. A party of four can sit under the name Mei, because you asked for her.
dialogue.glossYue: 得。四人一檯可以寫 Mei 個名，因為你幫佢訂。
dialogue.say: Yes. A party of four can sit under the name Mei, because you asked for her.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Would it be possible to change the time, and keep the reservation if we arrive later?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以改時間，如果我哋遲啲到，位仲留住？
dialogue.say: Would it be possible to change the time, and keep the reservation if we arrive later?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I can change the booking time to eight, and the indoor seat stays free if the sky turns wet.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以將訂位時間改到八點，如果落雨，室內位仍然留低。
dialogue.say: I can change the booking time to eight, and the indoor seat stays free if the sky turns wet.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If it rains heavily, please cancel the outdoor seat and keep us indoors beside the glass.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果落大雨，請取消室外位，留我哋喺室內近玻璃。
dialogue.say: If it rains heavily, please cancel the outdoor seat and keep us indoors beside the glass.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Those patio seats are already fully booked, but I can add the group to the waitlist.
dialogue.glossYue: 室外位已經滿咗，但我可以將你哋放上候補。
dialogue.say: Those patio seats are already fully booked, but I can add the group to the waitlist.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please confirm the booking for us, and roughly what time do we come for dinner?
dialogue.glossYue: 請確認訂位，大概幾點食飯？
dialogue.say: Please confirm the booking for us, and roughly what time do we come for dinner?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I will hold the booking until eight, and I will send a short note after we speak.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會留住個訂位到八點，傾完之後我會寄一則短訊。
dialogue.say: I will hold the booking until eight, and I will send a short note after we speak.
